findings.summary: `load_patterns()` calls `document.get()` without first requiring the decoded JSON root to be an object. A syntactically valid rules file whose root is `[]`, a string, or `null` raises uncaught AttributeError, yielding exit 1/traceback instead of the documented fail-closed STRICT result (exit 3 with WHY/FIX). Validate `document` is a dict and raise StrictRequired.

`load_patterns()` calls `document.get()` without requiring the decoded JSON root to be an object. A syntactically valid rules file rooted in an array, string, or null raises an uncaught AttributeError instead of producing the documented fail-closed STRICT result (exit 3 with WHY/FIX). Validate that `document` is a dict and raise `StrictRequired` otherwise.
